```yaml
name: Salesforce Code Analyzer

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  security-events: write

jobs:
  code-analyzer:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install Salesforce CLI
        run: |
          npm install -g @salesforce/cli
          sf plugins install code-analyzer

      - name: Run Salesforce Code Analyzer
        run: |
          mkdir -p reports
          
          # Run Code Analyzer with Recommended rules and SARIF output
          set +e
          sf code-analyzer run --target force-app --format sarif --output reports/code-analyzer.sarif --rules Recommended
          CA_EXIT_CODE=$?
          set -e
          
          # Verify SARIF file was generated
          if [ ! -f reports/code-analyzer.sarif ]; then
            echo "::warning::SARIF file not generated, creating empty one"
            echo '{"$schema":"https://json.schemastore.org/sarif-2.1.0.json","version":"2.1.0","runs":[{"tool":{"driver":{"name":"Salesforce Code Analyzer"}},"results":[]}]}' > reports/code-analyzer.sarif
          fi
          
          # Check for High/Critical violations
          # SARIF level mapping: Critical/High -> "error", Moderate -> "warning", Low/Info -> "note"
          HIGH_CRITICAL_COUNT=$(jq '[.runs[].results[] | select(.level == "error")] | length' reports/code-analyzer.sarif 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
          echo "High or Critical violations: $HIGH_CRITICAL_COUNT"
          
          if [ "$HIGH_CRITICAL_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::Found $HIGH_CRITICAL_COUNT High or Critical severity violations"
            exit 1
          fi

        with:

        if: always()
```

```yaml
name: PR Delta Validation

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  delta-validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # Ensure full git history for accurate diff
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install Salesforce CLI from npm
        run: npm install @salesforce/cli

      - name: Add Salesforce CLI to PATH
        run: echo "$PWD/node_modules/.bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install sfdx-git-delta plugin non-interactively
        run: |
          export SF_ACCEPT_ALL_LICENSES=true
          export SFDX_DISABLE_INSTALLATION_PROMPT=true
          sf plugins:install sfdx-git-delta --force
          echo "$HOME/.sfdx/node_modules/.bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Authenticate to production with JWT bearer flow
        env:
          SF_CONSUMER_KEY: ${{ secrets.SF_CONSUMER_KEY }}
          SF_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SF_USERNAME }}
          SF_JWT_KEY: ${{ secrets.SF_JWT_KEY }}
        run: |
          echo "$SF_JWT_KEY" > /tmp/jwt-key.pem
          chmod 600 /tmp/jwt-key.pem
          sf auth jwt:token \
            --client-id "$SF_CONSUMER_KEY" \
            --username "$SF_USERNAME" \
            --jwt-key /tmp/jwt-key.pem \
            --alias prod \
            --set-default-username

      - name: Fetch origin/main
        run: git fetch origin main

      - name: Compute delta package with sfdx-git-delta
        run: |
          sfdx-git-delta \
            --to HEAD \
            --from origin/main \
            --source force-app \
            --dir changed-sources

      - name: Run check-only deployment validation
        run: |
          DESTRUCTIVE_FILE="changed-sources/destructiveChanges.xml"
          if [ -f "$DESTRUCTIVE_FILE" ]; then
            sf project deploy start \
              --manifest changed-sources/package.xml \
              --target-org prod \
              --check-only \
              --test-level RunLocalTests \
              --wait 120
          else
            sf project deploy start \
              --manifest changed-sources/package.xml \
              --target-org prod \
              --check-only \
              --test-level RunLocalTests \
              --wait 120
          fi
```

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Creates a disposable scratch org for reviewing a feature branch.
# Usage: ./scripts/create-review-org.sh <alias>

# Fail fast: stop on first error, fail on unset variables, fail on errors in pipelines
set -euo pipefail

# Require exactly one positional argument (the alias for the new scratch org)
if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <alias>" >&2
  exit 1
fi

ALIAS="$1"

# 2) Create the scratch org from the standard scratch org definition.
#    - Uses the Dev Hub authenticated with the alias "devhub".
#    - The new org gets the provided alias.
#    - Expires after 3 days.
#    - Waits up to 20 minutes for the org to be ready.
sf org:create \
  --target-dev-hub devhub \
  --definition-file config/project-scratch-def.json \
  --alias "$ALIAS" \
  --duration-in-days 3 \
  --wait 20m

# 3) Deploy the force-app directory metadata to the new scratch org.
sf deploy \
  --target-org "$ALIAS" \
  --source-dir force-app

# 4) Assign the Sales_Ops permission set to the org's admin user.
sf user:permission-set:assign \
  --target-org "$ALIAS" \
  --permission-set-name "Sales_Ops"

# 5) Import sample records described by the data plan JSON file.
sf data:plan:import \
  --target-org "$ALIAS" \
  --plan data/sample-data-plan.json

# 6) Generate a password for the admin user.
sf user:password:generate \
  --target-org "$ALIAS" \
  --username admin

# 7) Print the org's login URL without opening a browser.
sf org:open \
  --target-org "$ALIAS" \
  --url-only
```

```yaml
name: PR Scratch Org CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - '**'

jobs:
  run-pr-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Salesforce CLI
        run: npm install -g @salesforce/cli

      - name: Authenticate to Dev Hub via JWT
        env:
          SALESFORCE_CONSUMER_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVHUB_CONSUMER_KEY }}
          SALESFORCE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DEVHUB_USERNAME }}
          SALESFORCE_JWT_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVHUB_JWT_KEY }}
        run: |
          echo "$SALESFORCE_JWT_KEY" > jwt.key
          sf org login jwt \
            --client-id "$SALESFORCE_CONSUMER_KEY" \
            --username "$SALESFORCE_USERNAME" \
            --jwt-key-file jwt.key \
            --set-default-org \
            --alias devhub
          rm -f jwt.key

      - name: Create scratch org
        run: |
          sf org create scratch \
            --target-dev-hub devhub \
            --definition-file config/project-scratch-def.json \
            --alias ci-scratch \
            --set-default-org \
            --wait 30

      - name: Deploy force-app source
        run: sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app --target-org ci-scratch

      - name: Run Apex tests with coverage
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          sf apex run test \
            --target-org ci-scratch \
            --code-coverage \
            --result-format junit \
            --output-dir test-results \
            --wait 60

      - name: Delete scratch org
        if: always()
        run: sf org delete scratch --target-org ci-scratch --noprompt --wait 10
```

```yaml
            --set-default \
            --alias devhub \
            --json
        env:
          DEVHUB_CONSUMER_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVHUB_CONSUMER_KEY }}
          DEVHUB_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DEVHUB_USERNAME }}
          DEVHUB_JWT_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVHUB_JWT_KEY }}

      - name: Create package version
        id: create_version
        run: |
          echo "Creating package version..."
          PACKAGE_VERSION=$(sf package:version:create \
            --package "acme-core" \
            --installation-key "" \
            --target-dev-hub devhub \
            --wait 60 \
            --json)
          
          echo "Package version output: $PACKAGE_VERSION"

          SUBSCRIBER_PACKAGE_VERSION_ID=$(echo "$PACKAGE_VERSION" | jq -r '.result.subscriberPackageVersionId')
          echo "Subscriber package version ID: $SUBSCRIBER_PACKAGE_VERSION_ID"

          echo "subscriber_package_version_id=$SUBSCRIBER_PACKAGE_VERSION_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        env:
          DEVHUB_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DEVHUB_USERNAME }}

  promote-version:
    name: Promote Package Version
    needs: create-version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: package-release
    steps:
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Salesforce CLI
        run: npm install -g @salesforce/cli

      - name: Authenticate to Dev Hub
        run: |
          echo "$DEVHUB_JWT_KEY" > jwt.key
          sf org login jwt \
            --client-id "$DEVHUB_CONSUMER_KEY" \
            --username "$DEVHUB_USERNAME" \
            --jwt-key-file jwt.key \
            --set-default \
            --alias devhub \
            --json
        env:
          DEVHUB_CONSUMER_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVHUB_CONSUMER_KEY }}
          DEVHUB_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DEVHUB_USERNAME }}
          DEVHUB_JWT_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVHUB_JWT_KEY }}

      - name: Promote package version
        id: promote_version
        run: |
          echo "Promoting package version ${{ needs.create-version.outputs.subscriber_package_version_id }}..."
          PROMOTE_OUTPUT=$(sf package:version:promote \
            --target-dev-hub devhub \
            --package "${{ needs.create-version.outputs.subscriber_package_version_id }}" \
            --no-prompt \
            --json)
          
          echo "Promote output: $PROMOTE_OUTPUT"

          IS_PROMOTED=$(echo "$PROMOTE_OUTPUT" | jq -r '.result.isPromoted')
          echo "Is promoted: $IS_PROMOTED"

          if [ "$IS_PROMOTED" != "true" ]; then
            echo "Failed to promote package version"
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          DEVHUB_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DEVHUB_USERNAME }}
```

```apex
public with sharing class ContactEmailMatcher {
    public class Request {
        @InvocableVariable(required=true)
        public String email;
    }

    public class Result {
        @InvocableVariable
        public Id contactId;
    }

    @InvocableMethod(label='Match Contact by Email')
    public static List<Result> match(List<Request> requests) {
        List<Result> results = new List<Result>();
        
        // Create a map to track the normalized email to the result index
        Map<String, List<Integer>> emailToIndices = new Map<String, List<Integer>>();
        
        // Normalize emails and group requests by normalized email
        for (Integer i = 0; i < requests.size(); i++) {
            String normalizedEmail = normalizeEmail(requests[i].email);
            if (!emailToIndices.containsKey(normalizedEmail)) {
                emailToIndices.put(normalizedEmail, new List<Integer>());
            }
            emailToIndices.get(normalizedEmail).add(i);
        }

        // Prepare results list with empty results
        for (Integer i = 0; i < requests.size(); i++) {
            results.add(new Result());
        }

        // Handle blank email cases by removing them from the query processing
        if (emailToIndices.containsKey('')) {
            emailToIndices.remove('');
        }

        if (!emailToIndices.isEmpty()) {
            // Build a set of normalized emails to query
            Set<String> normalizedEmails = emailToIndices.keySet();

            // Query contacts IDs grouped by normalized email with one SOQL
            // We'll query all relevant contacts and perform client-side matching
            List<Contact> allContacts = [
                SELECT Id, Email, CreatedDate
                FROM Contact
                WHERE Email != null AND Email != ''
                ORDER BY Email ASC, CreatedDate ASC, Id ASC
            ];

            // Create a map of normalized email to best matching contact (earliest CreatedDate, lowest Id)
            Map<String, Result> bestMatchByEmail = new Map<String, Result>();

            for (Contact c : allContacts) {
                String normalizedEmail = normalizeEmail(c.Email);
                if (!normalizedEmails.contains(normalizedEmail)) continue;

                if (!bestMatchByEmail.containsKey(normalizedEmail)) {
                    Result r = new Result();
                    r.contactId = c.Id;
                    bestMatchByEmail.put(normalizedEmail, r);
                }
            }

            // Assign matched contacts to respective results based on request order
            for (String normalizedEmail : emailToIndices.keySet()) {
                List<Integer> indices = emailToIndices.get(normalizedEmail);
                Result matchedContact = bestMatchByEmail.get(normalizedEmail);
                
                for (Integer idx : indices) {
                    if (matchedContact != null && matchedContact.contactId != null) {
                        results[idx] = matchedContact;
                    } else {
                        results[idx] = new Result(); // Unmatched, contactId remains null
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Ensure unmatched requests have null contactId
        for (Integer i = 0; i < requests.size(); i++) {
            if (results[i].contactId == null) {
                results[i] = new Result(); // Ensure unmatched requests have null contactId
            }
        }

        return results;
    }

    private static String normalizeEmail(String email) {
        if (email == null) return '';
        return email.trim().toLowerCase();
    }
}
```

```apex
public with sharing class LeadBulkLoader {
    /**
     * Inserts the given leads in a single DML statement with the
     * Lead_Set_Rating_From_Revenue flow action bypassed via TAF's bypass API.
     * All other Lead trigger actions still execute.
     * The bypass is always cleared, whether the insert succeeds or throws.
     */
    public static void load(List<Lead> leads) {
        if (leads == null || leads.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        // Bypass ONLY the Lead_Set_Rating_From_Revenue flow action
        TriggerActionFlow.bypass('Lead_Set_Rating_From_Revenue');

        try {
            insert leads;
        } finally {
            // Always clear the bypass, even if the DML threw
            TriggerActionFlow.clearBypass('Lead_Set_Rating_From_Revenue');
        }
    }
}
```

```apex
            Case old = oldMap.get(c.Id);
            if (c.Status == 'Closed' && old.Status != 'Closed') {
                comments.add(new CaseComment(
                    ParentId = c.Id,
                    CommentBody = 'Case closed on ' + String.valueOf(Date.today()),
                    IsPublished = false
                ));
            }
        }
        if (!comments.isEmpty()) {
            insert comments;
        }
    }
}
```
